record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: ROWLET, DARTIX and DECIDUEYE (the queued units, the whole line). ROWLET and DARTIX also declare the HATCH passive, which is separate and not part of this record.
record.summary: Line attack: draws a line from the caster through the current target, extended to 12 cells, and every enemy standing on a cell of that line (target and units behind it) takes special damage (25 raw at 1 star, 50 at 2, 75 at 3) and then a 4000 ms wound. Allies and empty cells are skipped.

targeting.who: every enemy on the supercover line from the caster through the current target to the board edge (the line stops where it leaves the board)

geometry.origin: the caster's cell (own cell is returned but skipped because it holds an ally)
geometry.direction: angle from the caster to the target, atan2 of the position differences; end cell = caster + 12 x (cos, sin), rounded; supercover cells between, off-board cells dropped
geometry.width: one cell per step of the supercover line; a step is horizontal, vertical or diagonal as decided by the algorithm

effects.scaling: requested amount, per enemy hit: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault is false); one crit roll shared by all hit enemies
effects.resolution: applied amount per enemy: the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), min 1) and later handleDamage modifiers; protect / skydiving / magicBounce block the hit for that enemy (the wound below is still attempted). takenDamage (includes shield damage) is not used

statusEffects.target: each enemy hit by the line
statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit: triggerWound takes the raw 4000 ms (no apBoost parameter); the duration does not depend on stars
statusEffects.applicationOrder: per cell: damage first, then wound, before moving to the next cell
statusEffects.guards: not applied if that unit's status has runeProtect. Applied duration: BLOODMOON weather multiplies the requested 4000 by 1.3; then applyStatusDurationReductions on that unit (shared status helper, see the sibling records DRAGON_CLAW / ZAP_CANNON); the timer and woundOrigin are replaced only if the new duration is longer than woundCooldown. The status flag is set (wound = true) before the duration check
statusEffects.combatEffect: a wounded unit receives no healing: handleHeal returns zero (Blood Moon + Blood Stone exception). Other users of status.wound (passives.ts, slashing-claw.ts, pokemon-entity.ts) were seen but not read

starBehavior.note: damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 4-star entry 150 and the fallback 150 are not reached by these units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). Wound duration has no star dependence. maxPP is 100 and range 3 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: The line follows the direction to the current target; enemies behind the target on the same line are hit, enemies beside it are not. Hits are decided by cells at cast time.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept on the caster: each cast re-hits the line; a repeat wound only extends the remaining timer if the new duration is longer. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw) damage per enemy: 25 (ROWLET) / 50 (DARTIX) / 75 (DECIDUEYE). Applied damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the SPE_DEF division and later handleDamage modifiers (min 1); takenDamage is not used. Requested wound: 4000 ms; applied: x1.3 under BLOODMOON, then status-duration reductions, none if runeProtect, and the timer only changes if longer.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
Target selection and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, canCast, range, movement)
Crit chance resolution (only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read)
unresolved: The cells list is built once before the callbacks run; behaviour when an enemy dies or moves during the iteration (a unit killed by an earlier cell's damage, death handling) was not traced
Which exact cells the supercover line includes for every angle and caster/target position (the algorithm was read, not enumerated for all geometries)
Whether any other item or synergy effect changes SPIRIT_SHACKLE beyond what is listed; the HATCH passive of ROWLET / DARTIX is not covered here

Consulted: effectInLine and getCellsBetween in app/core/board.ts, handleSpecialDamage, PokemonState.handleDamage, Status.triggerWound / updateWound (status.ts) and the sibling DRAGON_CLAW candidate. Queue record lists no routing uncertainties and no dependencies.
